description: List the queryable TIGER/Line geography layers in a Census TIGERweb ArcGIS service — census tracts, block groups, 2020 blocks, ZCTAs, congressional and state legislative districts, school districts, tribal areas, places, counties, PUMAs. Call this FIRST to get the layer_id that tigerweb_query needs; layer numbers differ between vintages, so never reuse one from memory.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring to filter layer names, e.g. "school"

include_label_layers.description: Include "... Labels" annotation layers (point labels, not boundaries). Default false.

service.description: TIGERweb service path, default TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Current. Others: TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Current, TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Census2020, TIGERweb/tigerWMS_ACS2023, Generalized_ACS2023/State_County, Census2020/tigerWMS_Census2020

name: tigerweb_list_layers
title: Tigerweb List Layers
